objective: Implement the evaluator first, freeze a fair pilot, and build a deterministic surface-Gaussian candidate. Evaluate against matched baselines under the frozen experiment policy; deliver evidence and an honest conclusion.

environment.verify_note: hardware read from sysctl/sw_vers at run time, not copied from a research table

policy_freeze.note: policy JSON read at evaluator-freeze time; hash recorded before candidate runs

phase0_evaluator.gate: Gate 0: evaluator fixtures pass, benchmark protocol frozen, baseline replayable
phase0_evaluator.tests: 20 passed in test_render_efficiency.py (identical=50, added error, nonfinite, wrong resolution, empty/thin mask, missing image, altered/duplicate/shortened view, coverage, gates)
phase0_evaluator.next_action: implement pilot freezer and deterministic build_surface_splats entry point

phase1_freeze_pilot.gate: Gate 1: fixed manifests, reviewed real detail, reproducible B0 baseline
phase1_freeze_pilot.note: deterministic trajectory-stride split produced and disjointness verified; near-duplicate grouping and a real visual review of separation remain before Gate 1 closes. B0 baseline not yet run.

phase2_calibration.gate: Gate 2: projection/visibility fixtures + real alignment limitations

phase3_surface_splats.gate: Gate 3: deterministic source-supported surface splat export
phase3_surface_splats.tests: 16 passed in test_surface_splats.py (tangent frames, covariance, quaternion, SH0 roundtrip, degenerate rejection, sample cap, colour interpolation, PLY export, nonfinite rejection)
phase3_surface_splats.smoke_run: scripts/build_surface_splats.py center --cameras 8 --max-samples 20000 --spacing 0.05 produced 20000 splats in 4.4s wall
phase3_surface_splats.note: geometry/covariance/export core built and verified; best-view colour wired via colour_the_scan; SPZ compression and Spark roundtrip remain for Gate 3.

phase4_msplat.gate: Gate 4: optional compatible backend trial or precise capability blocker

status_note: Phase 0 (evaluator) and the Phase 3 deterministic surface-Gaussian core are implemented and tested; a deterministic pilot split is produced but its independence is not yet visually reviewed.
